class.name: MaszynaRuntime
class.brief_description: Runtime-wide services shared by every on-disk cache.
class.description: Owns the single "throw the caches away" entry point and the build stamp those caches are keyed against. Every [ResourceCache] connects its own [method ResourceCache.clear] to [signal cache_clear_requested] when it is created, so a new cache is covered by "Clear cache" without its owner having to remember it. A manager that also keeps state in memory connects its own [code]clear_cache()[/code] to the same signal.

method.name: check_build_version
method.description: Compares the build stamp with the one stored in the user settings ([code]app/build_number[/code]) and, when they differ, emits [signal cache_clear_requested] and stores the current stamp. Returns whether the caches were cleared. Runs at most once per run and does nothing in a checkout that was never built. Call it from the entry point of a scene, before anything reads a cache.

method.name: clear_cache
method.description: Emits [signal cache_clear_requested], which clears every cache connected to it.

method.name: get_build_number
method.description: Returns the stamp written by the build itself ([code]cmake/write_build_number.cmake[/code]), so it names the library that is actually loaded. Empty in a checkout that was never built.

members.member: The language of the game's strings, named as its catalogue in the game's [code]lang/[/code] ([code]"pl"[/code] for [code]lang/pl.po[/code]); [code]"en"[/code] is the original's own strings, untranslated. Kept in the user settings; [MaszynaLocale] loads the catalogue.

signal.name: language_changed
signal.description: [member language] was set to another language.

signal.name: cache_clear_requested
signal.description: Emitted when every cache is to be dropped, by [method clear_cache] or by [method check_build_version].
